agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright at step 18 (theta -0.896 rad > 0.8 limit). Root cause is high sensor_noise (0.0183 near max) on seed 1: noisy angle/rate feedback causes the fixed-gain controller to apply large wrong-direction force (saturated at +67.78 N from step 15 onward) while the pole is leaning negative (theta -0.52 to -0.89). This drives positive feedback: cart accelerates to ~7.96 m/s and omega to -9.9 rad/s, energy grows to ~36.6 J (vs initial ~0.77 J + zero external work), pushing pole past the 0.8 rad limit. Removing only the noise (sensor_noise 0→0) stabilizes control and prevents the excursion.
